answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 7388 Country: United Kingdom Title: It has been on the news that some UK retailers use sludge, human waste, as fertiliser on their fruits and vegetable. My question is; would it be permissible to consume such products? Should we refrain from eating them? Question: Assalamu Alaikum It has been on the news that some UK retailers use sludge, human waste, as fertiliser on their fruits and vegetable. My question is; would it be permissible to consume such products? Should we refrain from eating them? Jazakallahukhairan Wassalam Answer ID: 7388 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1144/983=L/1429) It is allowed to eat such fruits and vegetables which were grown by sludge and human waste as fertiliser: الزروع المسقیۃ بالنجاسات لاتحرم و لاتکرہ عبد اکثر الفقھاء ( الشامی 9/492 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
